identity: Architect and poet · People's Republic of China · 1904–1955
title: Lin Huiyin's birth chart
metaDescription: Lin Huiyin's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 18.8° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the nine placements whose signs are settled stand in Gemini — the Sun, Venus, Mars and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 18.8° Gemini — deep enough in the second decan (10°–20°) that Venus, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Taurus (25.3°), Venus in Gemini (11.1°), Mars in Gemini (16.1°): thought with its feet on the ground, attraction that begins as conversation, effort aimed through strategy and words.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Saturn and Pluto hold the closest angle here — a trine, 0.8° wide. A trine is an open channel. The two cooperate without being asked, which is exactly why it is easy to spend and easy to take for granted. Behind it, the Sun conjunction Pluto at 1.3°, and Jupiter sextile Saturn at 2.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks one placement here. Saturn in Aquarius at 20.9° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Tallied where the signs are certain — 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day — the chart gives air 5, fire 2, earth 1, water 1, and mutable 5, fixed 2, cardinal 2 across the modes. Air signs carry exchange in the scheme — comparison, argument, the sentence that makes the situation legible. Saturn and Uranus were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Aries into Taurus during that day at the birthplace, travelling 12.7° between one midnight and the next. Which of the two it was depends entirely on the hour, and the hour is not recorded. Rather than pick the likelier half, the reading leaves the Moon open.
